kebab_example: aliyun ecd create-nas-file-system --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --office-site-id cn-hangzhou+dir-3633530000 --name testNAS --description testDescription --storage-type Capacity --encrypt-type 0 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateNASFileSystem

parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Name of the NAS file system.
The file name must follow these rules:

- Length: 2 to 128 English or Chinese characters.

- Must start with an uppercase or lowercase letter or a Chinese character, cannot start with http\:// or https\://.

- Can include numbers, underscores (\_), or hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: NAS文件系统名称。文件名称需遵循以下规则：长度为2\~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。可以包含数字、下划线（_）或短划线（-）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: Description of the NAS file system
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: Storage specification type of the NAS file system
parameters.help_zh: NAS文件系统的存储规格类型
parameters.name: storage_type

parameters.help_en: Whether the file system is encrypted. Uses KMS service-managed keys to encrypt the file system's on-disk data. No decryption is required when reading and writing encrypted data
parameters.help_zh: 文件系统是否使用KMS服务托管密钥，对文件系统落盘数据进行加密存储。在读写加密数据时，无需解密
parameters.name: encrypt_type
